title: Smart Data Models - Common schema definitions

dateModified.description: Property. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

name.description: Property. The name of this item.

alternateName.description: Property. An alternative name for this item.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

owner.description: Property. A List containing a JSON encoded sequence of characters referencing the unique Ids of the owner(s).

seeAlso.description: Property. list of uri pointing to additional resources about the item.

addressLocality.description: Property. The locality in which the street address is.

areaServed.description: Property. The geographic area where a service is provided.

name.description: Property. The name of the area.
